breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the given values were contradictory to the statement 'axial velocity is constant'. It resolved this by first calculating the axial velocity from the inlet conditions (W1, beta1) and then used this constant axial velocity to recalculate a new, consistent value for W2, explicitly stating it was 'overriding the given W2 = 100 m/s'. This perfectly matches the logic of the ground truth.
